int_name: E CAMBRIA ST & E THOMPSON ST

result.summary: The intersection features a large institutional building and residential row houses with sidewalks on both sides. While a marked crosswalk and traffic signal are present, the wide roadway and lack of pedestrian-specific signals or curb extensions create a moderately exposed environment for walkers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb near the intersection corner may block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the curb.

hazards.name: Incomplete Crossing Markings
hazards.description: Only one leg of the intersection appears to have a clearly marked crosswalk, leaving other crossing paths undefined.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and left side of the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility (continental or ladder) crosswalk markings on all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection in a mixed-use urban area with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. While these features provide a baseline of safety, the lack of traffic calming measures like curb extensions leaves pedestrians exposed to turning traffic over a moderate crossing distance.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing the risk of conflict with pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground corner near the silver car

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features sidewalks and curb ramps but lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals. One-way traffic and parked vehicles near the corner create potential visibility issues and unpredictable vehicle movements.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross, reducing driver awareness.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: Pedestrians must rely on vehicle signals, which may not provide adequate clearance time or clear right-of-way.
